name: 가시털오소리
appearance: Stocky charcoal and ivory striped badger with a dense ridge of dark porcupine-like quills, broad short legs and blunt snout.

motions.stand: Facing left, chest breathes, striped face blinks and blunt nose sniffs, ear twitches and dense quill ridge flexes gently, return to original four-footed ready pose.
motions.move: Facing left, compact quadruped trot in place, alternating diagonal pairs of short broad legs with clear foot lifts and planting, striped head stays low and dense quills sway coherently.
motions.attack1: Facing left, crouch the front shoulders and bristle the dark quill ridge, draw the blunt snout back then lunge forward left with a forceful head-and-forepaw swipe, retract and return to the stocky four-footed guard.
motions.hit1: Facing left, striped head winces and pulls right, front legs bend and quills flare defensively, recover to the original planted stance.
motions.die1: Facing left, front knees buckle and blunt snout lowers, stocky body rolls onto its side with quills settling and short legs relaxed, eyes close, finish motionless and recognizable.
